description: Estimates UK capital gains tax on selling a rental property, shares or another asset: gain after allowable costs, private residence relief where it applied, the annual exempt amount, tax at basic and higher rates based on the seller's income, and how much a joint sale with a spouse or civil partner would save.

annualIncome.description: The seller's gross annual income in GBP, which sets the CGT rate.

isMainResidence.description: Whether the property was ever the seller's main home.

monthsAsMainResidence.description: Months lived in as main home, for partial private residence relief.

otherGainsThisYear.description: Other capital gains already made this tax year in GBP.

ownershipType.description: Owned by one person or jointly with a spouse or civil partner.

purchaseCosts.description: Legal, survey and other buying costs in GBP.

sdltPaid.description: Stamp duty paid on purchase in GBP.

sellingCosts.description: Agent and legal selling costs in GBP.

totalMonthsOwned.description: Total months owned, for partial private residence relief.

name: calculate_capital_gains_tax
title: Calculate capital gains tax
